name: Ibirama (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Ibirama is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 547 of 21 May 1968: the green recalls the national flag and the red the state flag, with the municipal arms on the white.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown between branches
